subject.title: Feature: Inject context window % into system prompt runtime section

question: Should OpenClaw expose passive context-window usage in the system-prompt Runtime line, and what freshness/display contract should that field use?
rationale: The code path is bounded, but automation should not choose the permanent model-visible prompt contract for stale snapshots, compaction, model switches, and cache-boundary behavior.

options.title: Approve bounded Runtime context metadata
options.body: Add a compact context field only when usage is fresh or explicitly documented as previous-turn, with tests for stale data, compaction, model switches, and cache-boundary placement.

options.title: Keep explicit inspection only
options.body: Leave context usage on /status, /context, and session_status, then close this feature once maintainers decide passive prompt metadata is not desired.

options.title: Fold into runtime self-context design
options.body: Keep this issue linked to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/89537 and implement context usage only after that broader product surface is accepted.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded Runtime context metadata
recommendation.body: Add a compact context field only when usage is fresh or explicitly documented as previous-turn, with tests for stale data, compaction, model switches, and cache-boundary placement.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current history signal on the affected prompt Runtime path points to steipete, and this is a core prompt contract choice.
